research.title: Stabilized Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated a research question on how density ratio estimation uncertainty affects weighted conformal prediction when calibration and deployment distributions differ.
Led development of a weight stabilization procedure, evaluating interval coverage and width across simulated shifts and alternative density ratio estimators.

research.title: Partial Pooling for Subgroup Probability Calibration
bullets: Investigated whether partial pooling can stabilize subgroup probability calibration when labeled calibration data are scarce and subgroup prevalences differ.
Led development of an empirical Bayes calibration model with subgroup intercepts, comparing reliability diagrams and predictive losses against pooled and independent calibrators.

research.title: Robust Regression with Selectively Observed Outcomes
bullets: Formulated a research question about regression stability when selective outcome observation produces extreme inverse probability weights alongside contaminated response measurements.
Led development of propensity weighted Huber regression with overlap adaptive weight truncation, examining estimation error and sensitivity to observation model misspecification.

publications.title: Overlap-Adaptive Weight Truncation for Robust Regression with Selectively Observed Outcomes
Sensitivity of Propensity-Weighted Robust Regression to Observation Model Misspecification

work.title: Prediction Service Integration and Input Validation
bullets: Implemented input validation and batch prediction components for an internal forecasting service, handling missing fields and maintaining consistent preprocessing between training and inference.
Added regression tests for prediction interfaces, investigated failed processing jobs, and documented recovery procedures for malformed inputs and incompatible model artifacts.

projects.title: Regularization Paths for Correlated Regression Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression comparisons using synthetic correlated predictors and standardized preprocessing within cross validation folds.
Compared prediction error, coefficient stability, and variable selection behavior across regularization strengths, documenting differences between sparse and distributed signal settings.

projects.title: Variational and Sampling-Based Inference for Bayesian Regression
bullets: Implemented mean field variational inference and Gibbs sampling for Bayesian linear regression under conjugate priors using a shared model specification.
Compared posterior means, uncertainty intervals, and computational behavior against analytic reference calculations, examining sensitivity to predictor correlation and initialization.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Implemented logistic and isotonic calibration for probabilistic classifiers, separating model fitting, calibration, and evaluation data to prevent information leakage.
Compared log loss, Brier scores, and reliability diagrams under varying class imbalance, examining how calibration sample size affected method behavior.

projects.title: Kernel Two-Sample Testing for Distribution Shift
bullets: Implemented permutation tests based on maximum mean discrepancy and energy distance for detecting differences between reference and incoming feature distributions.
Compared rejection behavior under null simulations and controlled location, scale, and mixture shifts, assessing sensitivity to kernel bandwidth and dimensionality.
